gloss: one year; for one year; period of one year

definitions.gloss: one year; period of one year
definitions.explanation: A duration of one year. The {間|かん} suffix emphasizes a continuous span of time, distinguishing this from {一年|いちねん}, which can also mean 'first year.'

examples.japanese: {一年間|いちねんかん}{日本|にほん}に{住|す}んだ。
examples.english: I lived in Japan for one year.

examples.japanese: {一年間|いちねんかん}の{留学|りゅうがく}{経験|けいけん}がある。
examples.english: I have one year of study-abroad experience.

examples.japanese: この{保険|ほけん}は{一年間|いちねんかん}{有効|ゆうこう}で、{毎年|まいとし}{更新|こうしん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This insurance is valid for one year and must be renewed annually.

notes:
Adds the duration suffix {間|かん} to {一年|いちねん}, making the meaning unambiguously 'for one year' rather than 'first year.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一年間|いちねんかん}{続|つづ}く: to continue for one year
- {一年間|いちねんかん}の{予定|よてい}: a one-year plan
- {一年間|いちねんかん}{有効|ゆうこう}: valid for one year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一年|いちねん}: one year; first year — shorter, can be ambiguous between duration and ordinal
- {一年中|いちねんじゅう}: all year round; throughout the year
